summary:
Complete pixel asset package for the battle game: all 13 required ids authored as original pxl specs and shipped as validated sheets.

Fixes in this pass:
- Cleared the player_tank blocker. The failure was E_SEMANTIC "unknown palette cycle 'tread'" — the recipe ran palette_cycle against a cycle the shared palette never declared. I removed the cycle dependency entirely rather than rewriting palette.json (which would have dirtied every asset) and rebuilt the hull spec so tread motion comes from a full-silhouette value swap. player_tank now builds and validates under the default rules, with idle/move/fire across N/E/S/W.
- Wrote the ten untried assets from scratch: enemy_tank, bullet, explosion, hq_base, hud_stage_label, and tiles x, w, h, g, t. None of these previously had a recipe or spec.

Repairs that came out of harness diagnostics:
- enemy_tank, hq_base: chained palette_swap maps cancelled each other out (X->Y then Y->X), producing 0% frame diffs, and multi-stage outline ops padded shapes to 100% canvas bbox. Replaced with single-direction swaps on interior regions.
- explosion: the effect decay check flagged the burst growing instead of shrinking (34>43>60>94). Trimmed the last frame's value ramp so the peak now precedes the decay.
- h: the tile seam check found no edge pixel on the declared hazard ramp. Rebuilt the cross-hatch so the border and hazard motif both sit on that ramp.

Coverage: player_tank (16x16, N/E/S/W, idle 1 / move 2 / fire 2), enemy_tank (16x16, distinct darker silhouette), bullet (8x8 fly), explosion (16x16, 4-frame burst), hq_base (16x16 eagle emblem, idle + destroyed), hud_life_icon (8x8 ui), hud_stage_label (64x8 bitmap glyph strip), b (brick, seamless + break), x (steel plate with riveted corners, seamless + spark), w (water, 2-frame ripple), h (hazard cross-hatch, 2-frame), g (goal pad chevron, 2-frame), t (grass decor, seamless). Each ships with a .sheet.png and .sheet.json atlas; the shared monochrome palette.json is unchanged. Ready for publication.
